definitions.explanation: Describes something moving or resting in a soft, light, airy manner, like floating or drifting.
Describes a soft, fluffy texture or appearance.

examples.japanese: カーテンがふわっと{揺|ゆ}れた。
いい{香|かお}りがふわっと{漂|ただよ}ってきた。
examples.english: A pleasant scent drifted over softly.

examples.japanese: パンケーキがふわっと{焼|や}けた。

notes:
ONOMATOPOEIA TYPE:
Mimetic word ({擬態語|ぎたいご}) describing light, soft movement or texture.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ふわっと{浮|う}く (to float lightly)
・ふわっと{香|かお}る (to waft fragrantly)
・ふわっと{揺|ゆ}れる (to sway gently)
・ふわっと{仕上|しあ}がる (to turn out fluffy)

VARIATIONS:
・ふわふわ: repeated form emphasizing fluffy texture
・ふんわり: similar meaning, slightly more deliberate softness

COOKING USAGE:
Very common for describing desired texture of baked goods, eggs, etc.
